HOrbitalDiagonal.arithmetic_orbital_kernel_diagonal.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  (k : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K) :
  have w := fun q =>
    ∑' (t : Kˣ),
      NDivisorialShells.arithmeticIndentation K ((MasulloGRH.principalIdele K) t * x) *
        NDivisorialShells.arithmeticIndentation K
          ((MasulloGRH.principalIdele K) t * ((MasulloGRH.principalIdele K) q⁻¹ * x));
  have z := ↑x;
  HasSum (fun q => ↑(w q) * k (↑((MasulloGRH.principalIdele K) q⁻¹ * x)) z) (k z z) ∧
    HasSum (fun q => ‖↑(w q) * k (↑((MasulloGRH.principalIdele K) q⁻¹ * x)) z‖) ‖k z z‖
